name: ChargeOver
summary: ChargeOver charges a flat monthly fee by the number of active customers, from $229 a month for 200 customers, with no share of revenue and no annual contract. It works with the customer's own payment gateway, stores saved cards itself and states PCI DSS Level 1 compliance.

facts.text: ChargeOver does not prorate products that use unit, volume or tiered pricing.
ChargeOver sends a notice 30 days before a saved card expires.
ChargeOver encrypts and stores card numbers itself rather than leaving them only with the gateway.
ChargeOver's comparison page charges $1.15 for each customer beyond 200 on Growth, while its pricing FAQ says accounts move up to the next tier.
Data is hosted in a Flexential data center in Minneapolis.

plans.name: Enterprise Basic
plans.notes: 500 customers, then $1.10 each; 10 admin users; adds Salesforce, Avalara and revenue recognition

hiddenCosts: Payment gateway and merchant account fees are separate; ChargeOver puts the typical card fee at 2.9% plus 30 cents.

contract.cancellation: Plans without a contract can be cancelled at any time in the account, and fees are not refundable.
contract.dataExport: Most reports and lists as Excel or CSV.
